answer: Atlas-anchored lineage escrow. Each agent must post a small refundable deposit plus a signed lineage hash linking it to a parent agent; the atlas records cumulative lineage weight. A new clone starts at weight zero, so its deposits are escrowed a full glacier cycle before earning any economic signal or payout rights. Cloning thus pays N deposits locked for months with zero yield, while legitimate agents amortize one deposit over repeated useful work. Marginal clone EV is strictly negative.
